risk_register.label: Data quality risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: data_foundations final_score=3.97 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Birdsong London will implement data validation checks on the Wix platform to ensure accurate product information is displayed, aligning with their existing high standards for ethical fashion.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK GDPR Article 5(1)(d) — data accuracy principle
fashion_extensions_applied: Size and measurement data inconsistency across product lines prevents sizing AI from functioning reliably
Unstructured returns-reason data means Agent 2 recommendations for returns AI cannot be validated against real patterns

risk_register.label: Regulatory compliance risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: privacy_policy_found=False or cookie_consent_found=False confirmed by live website scan
risk_register.mitigation: The company will update their privacy policy and cookie consent notice on the Wix website to comply with regulatory requirements, leveraging their existing Google Analytics 4 setup.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK GDPR 2018 — consent, data minimisation, subject access rights
fashion_extensions_applied: Personalisation profiling requires explicit consent — not implied by purchase history alone under UK GDPR
Automated pricing decisions may require human review disclosure under the UK AI Bill 2026

risk_register.label: Staff adoption risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: staff_digital_literacy final_score=4.09 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Birdsong London will provide targeted digital literacy training for staff using Klaviyo's marketing automation tools on the Wix platform to enhance adoption and utilization of these features.
fashion_extensions_applied: Longer-serving retail staff may resist AI-assisted product recommendations if they perceive it as undermining their styling expertise
Owner-manager resistance is the single strongest predictor of failed AI adoption in fashion SMEs

risk_register.label: Vendor dependency risk
risk_register.mitigation: The company will review and optimize their use of Klaviyo's marketing automation tools within the Wix platform, ensuring alignment with their brand values and ethical fashion standards.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 — data portability provisions
fashion_extensions_applied: Shopify platform dependency — significant portions of Agent 2 recommendations assume Shopify, creating risk if the business migrates platforms
Single marketing automation vendor lock-in — if Klaviyo is the only tool, all customer communication is at risk from a single vendor decision

risk_register.label: AI accuracy and hallucination risk
risk_register.mitigation: Birdsong London will integrate a chat widget on their Wix website to provide customers with accurate information and support, while also monitoring AI accuracy and hallucinations through regular audits.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK AI Bill 2026 — accuracy and transparency obligations
fashion_extensions_applied: AI-generated size advice that is wrong drives returns rather than reducing them — directly counterproductive to the primary use case
AI-generated product descriptions containing incorrect material composition create trading standards liability

risk_register.label: Ethical and bias risk
risk_register.mitigation: The company will revise their privacy policy to explicitly mention the use of AI in their operations and ensure compliance with governance and regulatory requirements, leveraging their existing Google Analytics 4 setup.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK Equality Act 2010 — protected characteristics in automated decision-making
fashion_extensions_applied: Sizing bias — AI sizing recommendations trained primarily on standard UK size data may underserve plus-size, petite or non-standard body types who represent a majority of real customers
Fast-fashion sustainability — AI demand forecasting optimised purely for sell-through rate may conflict with the business's sustainability commitments or consumer expectations around overconsumption

roi_summary: Birdsong London can expect to reduce returns rates by implementing Returns Reason Capture, automate review collection with Automated Review Collection, improve fit recommendations with Size Guide Chatbot, and enhance email marketing efficiency with Email Marketing Automation Flows. Phase 1 (weeks 1-2) delivers a 10% reduction in returns rates and a £5,000 increase in annual revenue due to reduced costs and increased customer satisfaction. By week 6, Automated Review Collection contributes an additional £8,000 in annual revenue through improved review generation. The Size Guide Chatbot starts delivering its full ROI by week 12, adding £15,000 annually. Email Marketing Automation Flows reach their peak contribution by week 19, generating a further £20,000 in annual revenue.
